# sh-fpv-footer

Profile-end footer. States per the Android prototype (source of truth): Default (sealed teaser in tail), Sealed (teaser detail), and Settled rest states — the reward card embedded in-page after the reveal overlay is dismissed (Quote / Success story / Premium unclaimed & claimed, CTA flips to "Free Unlock Claimed"). The reveal overlays are reference frames beside this set, NOT states.

Full profile view (migration, not yet core) · 6 variants · Figma node `2597:22556`

*Generated by `tools/components.py` from Figma. Values are token names; never copy numbers.*
